name: settings-form
title: Settings Form
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A long edit form in sections, saved as a whole (account, company, preferences). `SettingsForm` is a react-aria `Form` that only shows state the app owns: `isDirty` (enables Save and Discard), `isPending` (spinner on Save, `aria-busy`) and `onReset` (adds a Discard button that should restore the saved values), so react-hook-form or any other form state fits. `SettingsSection` groups fields under a `title` and `description` (a labelled group) stacked above them, leaving the width to the fields next to an app sidebar; the fields fall into a two-column grid when there's room (container query), and `col-span-full` takes the whole row. `SettingsFormFooter` is a save bar stuck to the bottom of the viewport with a polite status line (no changes / unsaved / saving), optional children before the buttons, Discard and Save. Warning before leaving with unsaved changes stays in the app (it depends on the router; use `confirm-dialog`). Built-in text is in English; translate it with `i18n.labels`.
